Cancer bioelectricity literature repository, 2006-11-02 to 2026-11-02.
Run harvest.py, then supplement.py, to reproduce retrieval. package.py assembles the site data from those outputs.
All records are candidates awaiting screening. Topic labels indicate query matches, not confirmed mechanisms.
The data_files list in search-log.json contains the catalogue shards. Search-log.json records queries and retrieval counts.
Metadata only. No copyrighted full texts are redistributed.
